The '''''Republic''''' was a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was docked on the stern of the vessel, near the engines. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] communicated with several freighters from the ship, clearing them to join with the fleet.

The ''Republic'' served as a temporary [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] for [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] after the loss of the [[Nespis VIII]] [[Nespis VIII|spaceport]]. Most of the prominent leaders of the New Republic military were present at a meeting there, where the future strategies against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] were discussed.
